title: decisions profile — entry front matter (spec 1)
description: MADR 4.0 front matter plus the `register` extension block. Validates front matter only; body structure is MADR's concern (see madrlint).

status.description: MADR status. This profile never uses `proposed` — entries are born accepted.

slug.description: The identity. Unique per register; must match the filename after the date prefix.

surfaces.description: Globs or paths this decision governs. What an agent matches against before loading it.

obsoletes.description: AUTHORED. Entries this one replaces entirely.

updates.description: AUTHORED. Entries this one substantively amends; those remain in force.

obsoleted-by.description: CACHED. Maintained by tooling from the graph; never hand-written.

updated-by.description: CACHED. Maintained by tooling from the graph; never hand-written.

bead.description: Optional. A minted `decision`-type bead id. Mint before citing; the file remains the source of truth.

legacy-id.description: Optional. The pre-migration identifier (e.g. `A47`), so existing citations keep resolving.

ref.description: A slug, or `<repo>#<slug>` for a cross-register reference.
